use_case_name: Update the Facility Map and Displayed Devices

evidence_cards.content: The GUI shall allow the facility map to be modified without requiring programming effort.

evidence_cards.content: The GUI shall allow devices to be added and removed from the display without requiring programming effort.

evidence_cards.content: The system must allow the following scheduled operations at a minimum during 'normal' operational mode: Sequence #1 Goal State: Open South Bound (AM) / Initial State: Closed (PM), Sequence #2 Goal State: Closed (AM) / Initial State: Open South Bound (AM), Sequence #3 Goal State: Open North Bound (PM) / Initial State: Closed (AM), Sequence #4 Goal State: Closed (PM) / Initial State: Open North Bound (PM).
